{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|I promise you that I will find her the best, most decent, most honest, hardest working lawyer I can.''"<br />"''Oh. I was trying to get her someone who'd win.|[[Jagged Fel]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], on finding a lawyer to represent Tahiri Veila|<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>}}
A '''lawyer''' or '''attorney'''<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref> was a person who was involved in the practice of law, such as representing individuals or organizations before court.<ref name="Allies" />

On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stassia]], the term 'Defender' was used.<ref name="Ringers">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref>

Some [[Legal-analyst droid|droids]], such as the [[C4LR litigation droid]], were fully accredited to work within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] legal system.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>

[[Nawara Ven]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] pilot and member of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], was a lawyer prior to joining the Rogues. He was the defense lawyer for [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] when he was put on [[Trial of Tycho Celchu|trial]] for [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. Ven was close to the [[New Jedi Order]] and, in [[44 ABY]], was the defense counsel for [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] when the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] under [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] pursued legal action against Skywalker for the actions of [[Darth Caedus]] in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The Order also asked Ven to defend ex-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]] when she was [[Trial of Tahiri Veila|put on trial]] for [[Second Battle of Fondor|murdering]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], but the court refused Ven as defense counsel, citing his closeness with the Order. The trial occurred in the [[Ninth Hall of Justice]], where Veila was prosecuted by [[Sul Dekkon]], a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] advocate appointed by Daala, and defended by [[Eramuth Bwua'tu]], [[Esquire]], a well-respected [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] with a long career in law who came out of retirement to take Veila's case.<ref name="Allies" />
